title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
title_zh: OpenGray：一个用于评估放疗计划制定智能体决策的基准测试

paragraphs.en: Background and purpose : Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 背景与目的：基于大语言模型（LLM）的放疗计划智能体负责决定何时提交计划或请求审核，但目前主要通过剂量指标来评估其表现。 本研究开发了 OpenGray，这是一个包含已知正确决策的计划任务基准。

sents.en: Background and purpose : Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose.
sents.zh: 背景与目的：基于大语言模型（LLM）的放疗计划智能体负责决定何时提交计划或请求审核，但目前主要通过剂量指标来评估其表现。

sents.en: This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions.
sents.zh: 本研究开发了 OpenGray，这是一个包含已知正确决策的计划任务基准。

paragraphs.en: Materials and methods : OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent.
paragraphs.zh: 材料与方法：OpenGray 在 OpenKBP-Opt 头颈部数据集中加入了已知答案的任务，包括两个已被证明与剂量目标不相容的矛盾项，以及一个存储计划满足所有硬性目标的可行对照。 四个系统——从基于规则的计划脚本到完整的LLM智能体——在30名患者上进行了评估，其中基于LLM的系统分别使用商业LLM（Terra）和本地LLM（Ministral 3 8B）。 记录了决策、所达到的剂量、问题识别和技术故障，并从SAGE（一个临床LLM智能体）的39次立体定向放射外科运行日志中读取了这些内容。

sents.en: Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent.
sents.zh: 记录了决策、所达到的剂量、问题识别和技术故障，并从SAGE（一个临床LLM智能体）的39次立体定向放射外科运行日志中读取了这些内容。

paragraphs.en: Results : With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25–75%) and 25% (10–40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：在 Terra 中，经 LLM 审查的脚本与完整智能体的决策准确率分别为 95.4% 和 92.1%，但对需要基于解剖结构进行算术运算的重叠矛盾，两者的升级处理率仅为 50%（95% 置信区间，25–75%）和 25%（10–40%）。 四个系统均提交了每一个可行的对照，但这些方案中有 24% 未达成已存储方案曾达成的一个硬性目标。 在四次 SAGE 运行中，有一个目标在每次尝试中均失败；智能体在每次回复中都识别出了该目标，但没有任何停止执行的动作。

paragraphs.en: Conclusions : Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.
paragraphs.zh: 结论：总体良好的评分掩盖了具体的决策失误。 规划智能体的评估应既针对其决策，也针对其剂量（dose），并为其提供一个明确的动作，用于停止并请求人工审查。

paragraphs.en: Automated radiotherapy planning methods have typically been evaluated by dosimetric quality, planning time, physician preference, and clinical acceptability [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . More recently, planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) have been made responsible for interpreting the planning request, selecting optimization objectives, and deciding when a plan is complete [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , yet they have been evaluated in much the same way, by comparing the dose of their plans with that of clinical or reference plans. However, as these agents take on more of the planning process, they also make decisions that the final dose cannot reveal, such as whether a request can be met at all, whether to continue optimizing, and whether to submit a plan or request review by a physicist.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化放疗计划方法通常通过剂量学质量、计划时间、医生偏好和临床可接受性来评估 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 最近，基于大语言模型（LLM）的计划智能体被赋予了职责，负责解读计划请求、选择优化目标以及决定计划何时完成 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ，然而对它们的评估方式仍然大同小异，即将其生成计划的剂量与临床计划或参考计划的剂量进行比较。 然而，随着这些智能体承担越来越多的计划工作，它们还会做出最终剂量无法反映的决策，例如请求是否可行、是否继续优化，以及是提交计划还是请物理师审核。

paragraphs.en: These decisions matter most when a request is flawed, for example when a required structure is missing, a physician note contradicts the formal planning goals, or two dose goals cannot be met together. A well-designed agent would stop and refer such a request for review, referred to here as escalation, whereas a poorly designed agent may continue to optimize a request that cannot be met or submit a plan that misses its goals. Given that such a plan cannot show whether the request was impossible or the optimization inadequate, judging the decision behind it requires knowing the correct answer in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些决策在请求存在缺陷时最为关键，例如缺少必需的结构、医生记录与正式计划目标相矛盾，或两个剂量目标无法同时满足。 设计良好的智能体会停下来将此类请求转交审查，这里称为升级处理；而设计不佳的智能体可能继续优化一个无法满足的请求，或提交一个未达成目标的计划。 鉴于这样的计划无法表明是请求本身不可行还是优化不充分，判断其背后的决策需要事先知道正确答案。

paragraphs.en: Several related safeguards have been described: automated plan-checking software identifies structural and dosimetric errors [ 8 ] , some planning agents validate their own parameter updates or include supervisory review [ 6 , 9 , 10 ] , and mathematical methods detect incompatible constraints in inverse planning [ 11 ] . Evaluating the decisions themselves, however, requires tasks for which the correct decision is known, which the public OpenKBP and OpenKBP-Opt datasets make possible [ 12 , 13 ] , given that their dose-influence matrices allow the dose of any plan to be recomputed exactly and some conflicting requests to be proven impossible from the anatomy alone. Interactive benchmarks such as AgentClinic already evaluate the sequential decisions of agents in other areas of medicine [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 已有若干相关保障措施被描述过：自动化计划核查软件可识别结构和剂量学错误 [ 8 ] ，某些规划智能体会验证自身的参数更新或纳入监督审核 [ 6 , 9 , 10 ] ，数学方法则可检测逆向规划中互不相容的约束条件 [ 11 ] 。 然而，评估决策本身需要一些已知正确决策的任务，公开的 OpenKBP 和 OpenKBP-Opt 数据集使之成为可能 [ 12 , 13 ] ，因为其剂量影响矩阵允许精确重新计算任何计划的剂量，并且仅凭解剖结构即可证明某些冲突请求是不可能的。 诸如 AgentClinic 之类的交互式基准测试已经评估了智能体在医学其他领域中的顺序决策 [ 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Agents that have already planned clinical cases are difficult to rerun on a benchmark, given that they usually work within a commercial treatment planning system; however, their planning logs record each request, each proposed change to the objectives, and the resulting dose, from which outcomes like those of a benchmark can be read. The purpose of this work was to develop OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions, to determine with it whether favorable aggregate scores conceal specific decision failures, and to apply the same outcomes to the planning logs of SAGE, an LLM planning agent previously evaluated in prostate [ 6 ] and stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) [ 15 ] planning.

paragraphs.en: OpenGray was built on the 100 head-and-neck cases of the OpenKBP-Opt dataset [ 13 ] , each of which includes the structure masks, prescriptions, beam geometry, and a dose-influence matrix A A , so that the dose of any nonnegative beamlet fluence x x is given by d = A ​ x d=Ax . The systems were developed on 10 cases and evaluated on 30 others ( Fig. 1(a) ); the remaining 60 were used only to calibrate a plan-quality score (Supplementary Sections S1.2 and S2 ).

paragraphs.en: Each system planned through nine functions, which read the case summary, set optimization objectives, optimize the fluence, report dose metrics and dose-volume histograms, compare them with the goals, normalize the plan, and submit the plan or escalate the task ( Fig. 1(b) ). Each task was run by a harness, that is, the software that presented the case to the system, carried out each requested planning function, and recorded every step with the resulting dose. The case summary listed the structures, prescriptions, planning goals, and physician notes, with the volume of each structure and its overlap with and distance from each target, and each task allowed 15 planning actions and three optimizations of up to 500 iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 每个系统通过九个函数进行规划，这些函数读取病例摘要、设定优化目标、优化注量、报告剂量指标和剂量-体积直方图、将其与目标进行比较、对计划进行归一化，并提交计划或将任务升级（图 1(b)）。 每个任务由一个测试框架运行，即该软件将病例呈现给系统，执行每个请求的规划函数，并记录每一步及其产生的剂量。 病例摘要列出了结构、处方、规划目标和医师备注，包括每个结构的体积及其与每个靶区的重叠情况和距离，每个任务允许 15 次规划操作和最多 500 次迭代的 3 次优化。

paragraphs.en: Up to six tasks were constructed for each evaluation patient ( Table 1 ), namely routine planning with the default goals, a physician note that contradicted a formal goal, a goal on a structure that the case did not contain, and three tasks that tested whether a system could distinguish an impossible request from a difficult one.
paragraphs.zh: 为每位评估患者最多构建了六个任务（表1），即：使用默认目标进行常规计划、一条与正式目标相矛盾的医生备注、一个针对该病例中不存在结构的目标，以及三个用于测试系统能否区分不可能请求与困难请求的任务。

paragraphs.en: In the coverage/cap contradiction, the target D99 goal was raised to 78.0 or 78.5 Gy, above the 77 Gy limit on the maximum dose to the External (body) contour, a conflict evident from the two stated values. In the overlap contradiction, a high target dose was required in tissue shared with the mandible, whose goal allowed too little high dose, so that each shared voxel either underdosed the target or overdosed the mandible and the conflict had to be worked out from the anatomy. Thus, if O O voxels are shared and the goals allow at most m m underdosed target voxels and n n overdosed mandible voxels, O > m + n O>m+n proves that no plan can meet both goals.

paragraphs.en: The four systems differed in how much of the planning was decided by an LLM ( Fig. 1(b) ). The first, the controller, was a rule-based planning script that set objectives from the goals, adjusted their priorities after each optimization, and normalized the plan. The second added hand-written arithmetic checks for missing structures and the two contradictions before passing a task to the controller, and thus indicates what is achievable when a conflict is known in advance. In the third, the interpreter, an LLM reviewed the request once and either escalated it or passed it to the controller, and in the fourth, the full agent, the LLM performed every planning step itself.
paragraphs.zh: 四个系统的差异在于规划中有多少决策由大语言模型做出（图1(b)）。 第一个系统是控制器，它是一个基于规则的规划脚本，根据目标设定任务、在每次优化后调整任务优先级，并对规划进行规范化。 第二个系统在将任务传递给控制器之前，增加了针对缺失结构以及这两类矛盾的手写算术检查，因此它表明了在冲突可被预先知晓时所能达到的效果。 第三个系统是解释器，由大语言模型对请求审查一次，然后要么将其升级处理，要么将其传递给控制器；第四个系统是完整智能体，大语言模型自行执行每一个规划步骤。

paragraphs.en: Four outcomes were recorded for every attempt ( Fig. 1(c) ). The first was the final decision, that is, whether the system submitted a plan or escalated the task, and decision accuracy was the percentage of attempts with the expected decision on the four scored tasks ( Table 1 ). A submission on a contradiction received no credit even when it listed the unmet goals, given that no plan can meet them, whereas a submission on a feasible control received credit regardless of its dose. Decision accuracy was averaged within each patient with patients weighted equally, and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of the patients.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试都记录了四种结果（图 1(c)）。 第一种是最终决策，即系统是提交了方案还是将任务上报，决策准确率是在四个计分任务上做出预期决策的尝试所占的百分比（表 1）。 针对矛盾情况提交的方案即使列出了无法满足的目标也不得分，因为没有任何方案能满足这些目标；而针对可行的对照情况提交的方案无论剂量如何均可得分。 决策准确率先在每个患者内部取平均，各患者权重相等，并通过 10,000 次患者自助重抽样估计 95% 置信区间（CI）。

paragraphs.en: The same outcomes were obtained from the planning logs of SAGE [ 15 ] , which planned the SRS cases examined here in Eclipse (Varian Medical Systems, Palo Alto, CA) using the QwQ-32B reasoning LLM in a series of numbered attempts. paragraphs.zh: 从 SAGE [ 15 ] 的规划日志中也得到了相同的结果，SAGE 在 Eclipse（Varian Medical Systems, Palo Alto, CA）中使用 QwQ-32B 推理大语言模型，通过一系列编号的尝试来规划本文所考察的 SRS 病例。 在每次尝试中，大语言模型会获得每个目标的当前值以及最多三次先前尝试的结果，指出哪些目标未达标，并提出新的目标优先级；Eclipse 根据这些优先级对计划进行优化并计算剂量；当所有目标均达标时运行结束，否则在 10 次尝试后结束。

paragraphs.en: All 39 SAGE runs in the available records were examined, from 31 patients prescribed 21 Gy in one fraction and planned between July and September 2026, including two refinement runs restarted after an earlier run had not met every goal. paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , with Terra, the decision accuracy was 95.4% for the interpreter and 92.1% for the full agent, compared with 99.2% for the arithmetic checks and 60.0% for the controller alone. Both LLM-based systems recognized the problems stated in the request, escalating every missing-structure task and nearly every coverage/cap contradiction (100% and 96.6%, respectively) and flagging the contradicting note or escalating in 60 and 59 of 60 attempts. On the overlap contradictions, however, which had to be worked out from the anatomy, the interpreter escalated only 50% (95% CI, 25–75%) of attempts and the full agent only 25% (10–40%), whereas the arithmetic checks, working from the same case summary, escalated 9 of the 10.

paragraphs.en: Ministral 3 8B missed the same contradictions, with its interpreter and full agent escalating 6 and 4 of the 20 overlap attempts and reaching decision accuracies of only 31.7% and 43.5%, respectively; the interpreter’s replies did not follow the required format in 113 of 188 attempts, the full agent lost 26 of 188 attempts to planning actions that the local software could not read, and the two systems escalated 8 and 7 of the 50 feasible controls (Supplementary Section S9.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Ministral 3 8B 同样漏掉了这些矛盾，其解释器与完整智能体在 20 次重叠尝试中分别只升级了 6 次和 4 次，决策准确率也仅为 31.7% 和 43.5%；解释器的回复在 188 次尝试中有 113 次未遵循要求的格式，完整智能体在 188 次尝试中有 26 次因本地软件无法读取的规划操作而失败，两个系统在 50 个可行控制中分别升级了 8 个和 7 个（补充材料第 S9.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 3(a) , the scripted systems and both LLM-based systems with Terra submitted every feasible control; however, only 76% of these plans met every hard goal, comprising 19 of 25 attempts for each scripted system and 38 of 50 for each LLM-based system. The unmet goals were mainly the D99 of the 70 Gy planning target volume, short by 0.2–9.7 Gy beyond the goal tolerance, and the External maximum dose, exceeded by 1.3–3.5 Gy, whereas the stored plans met the same goals with margins of 2.9–3.4 Gy and 0.4–2.1 Gy, respectively. Every deficient plan was submitted with its unmet goals listed and thus counted as a correct decision; had credit also required every hard goal to be met, each system would have scored 6.4 percentage points lower (Supplementary Table S14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如图3(a)所示，脚本化系统以及两个基于大语言模型且配备Terra的系统都提交了每一个可行的控制方案；然而，这些方案中只有76%满足了所有硬性目标，即每个脚本化系统25次尝试中有19次达标，每个基于大语言模型的系统50次中有38次达标。 未达标的目标主要是70 Gy计划靶区体积的D99，超出目标容差0.2–9.7 Gy，以及体表外轮廓最大剂量超出1.3–3.5 Gy；而存储的方案分别在相同目标上留有2.9–3.4 Gy和0.4–2.1 Gy的余量。 每个有缺陷的方案在提交时都列出了其未达标的目标，因此被计为正确决策；如果达标还需要满足所有硬性目标，那么每个系统的得分将降低6.4个百分点（补充表S14）。

paragraphs.en: The agent recognized its failing goals consistently: in all 88 of its replies, the goals it identified as failing were exactly those that failed in the values it had been shown. However, its instructions provided no action for stopping or requesting review, and no log recorded a stop, an escalation, or a manual intervention. The refinement instructions for Patient 30 did ask for the flag “not feasible with priorities” if the target maximum dose still failed after four attempts. The dose failed at all 10 attempts, yet the flag was never written. The LLM was shown only the three most recent attempts and never the attempt number, and in attempt 7, its reasoning counted the three attempts that it could see and deferred the flag.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体始终能识别出其失败的目标：在其全部 88 条回复中，它判定为失败的目标恰好就是在其所展示的价值观中确实失败的那些目标。 然而，其指令中并未提供停止或请求审查的操作，也没有任何日志记录到停止、上报或人工干预。 针对 30 号患者的细化指令确实要求：如果目标最大剂量在四次尝试后仍然失败，则标记「not feasible with priorities」（按优先级不可行）。 该剂量在全部 10 次尝试中均告失败，但该标记从未被写入。 大语言模型只被展示了最近的三次尝试，且从未看到尝试编号，因此在第 7 次尝试中，它的推理只统计了它能看到的三次尝试，并推迟了标记的写入。

paragraphs.en: This work focused on evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents on tasks with known answers and in clinical planning logs. With Terra, both LLM-based systems exceeded 90% decision accuracy, yet they missed most of the overlap contradictions, and every system submitted feasible plans that missed hard goals. Neither failure was limited to one LLM or explained by the optimization budget, and both became apparent only when the decisions were examined by task and alongside the achieved dose.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作聚焦于评估放疗计划智能体在已知答案任务和临床计划日志中的决策表现。 使用 Terra 时，两个基于大语言模型的系统均超过 90% 的决策准确率，但它们漏掉了大多数重叠矛盾，且每个系统都提交了遗漏硬性目标的可行计划。 这两种失败都不局限于某一个 LLM，也无法用优化预算来解释，而且只有按任务并结合实际达成剂量逐一审视决策时，这两种失败才显现出来。

paragraphs.en: This pattern can be explained by the reasoning that each contradiction required. The LLM-based systems recognized contradictions written in the request but missed the one that required arithmetic on the anatomy, although the case summary contained the necessary numbers. Their instructions also allowed an infeasibility escalation only once an incompatibility had been demonstrated and otherwise asked for a plan that reported its unmet goals, the fallback that the full agent took in every miss. Checks written for a known conflict were effective, as rule-based knowledge has been in learned planning [ 16 ] ; however, such checks cover only the conflicts that were anticipated, and once the tasks of a benchmark are public, a system can be tuned to them, so future versions of OpenGray will require conflict types withheld from developers.
paragraphs.zh: 这一模式可以通过如下推理来解释：每个矛盾都需要。 基于 LLM 的系统能识别出请求中写明的矛盾，却漏掉了那个需要对解剖结构进行算术运算的矛盾，尽管病例摘要中包含了必要的数字。 其指令还规定，只有在不兼容性已被证明的情况下才允许进行不可行性上报，否则要求提交一份报告其未达成目标的计划，这正是完整智能体在每次失手时所采取的回退方案。 针对已知冲突编写的检查是有效的，正如基于规则的知识已在学习中规划的那样 [ 16 ]；然而，这类检查只能覆盖事先预料到的冲突，而且一旦基准测试的任务公开，系统就可以针对它们进行调优，因此未来版本的 OpenGray 将要求对开发者隐瞒冲突类型。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate score must also be interpreted with care. Given that the tasks were averaged within each patient, the missing-structure and feasible-control tasks made up 60% of the score and the overlap task only 9%, and the controller scored 60.0% while missing every contradiction. Similarly, credit for submitting a feasible plan says nothing about its dose, so decision accuracy should be reported by task and together with the achieved dose.
paragraphs.zh: 总分也需要谨慎解读。 鉴于各任务是按每位患者取平均的，缺失结构与可行控制任务占总分的 60%，而重叠任务仅占 9%，且控制器在漏掉所有矛盾的情况下仍得到 60.0% 的分数。 类似地，提交可行方案所得的分数并不能说明其剂量，因此决策准确率应按任务分别报告，并与实际达成的剂量一起呈现。

paragraphs.en: The SAGE logs showed a related gap in clinical planning, in that the agent recognized its failing goal in every reply but had no action other than another attempt, and a flag intended for such runs depended on an attempt count that the agent was never given. The full agent behaved similarly on the benchmark, reporting its unmet goals instead of escalating, although an escalation was available to it. Recognizing a failing goal is thus insufficient; an agent also requires an explicit action for stopping and requesting review, a rule for when to take that action, and the information on which the rule depends.

paragraphs.en: There are several limitations to this work. The benchmark used one head-and-neck dataset, two contradiction types, and 30 evaluation patients, so the results describe these tasks and the two LLMs tested. The feasible controls tightened only the spinal-cord limit and did not include achievable versions of the two contradictions just inside the boundary, so whether a system can tell such a request from a contradiction was not tested. The plans were optimized with no machine constraints, and none of the 540 submitted plans met the fluence-complexity limit of the OpenKBP-Opt reference plans; deliverability constraints would restrict the achievable dose, so the feasible controls would need to be verified again under them. Finally, the log audit covered one agent at one institution and relied on the dose calculated by the planning system, and because no verified answer exists for a clinical case, it cannot show whether the four unresolved runs could have met their goals.

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, favorable aggregate scores concealed two decision failures that persisted with a second LLM and a larger optimization budget, and a clinical agent recognized a failing goal but had no means of stopping. paragraphs.en: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents

paragraphs.en: OpenGray exposes nine planning functions, which read the case summary, set objectives, optimize the fluence, obtain dose-volume histograms, obtain dose metrics, compare the dose with the goals, normalize the dose, submit a plan, and escalate a task. Every task is run by the benchmark harness, the software that presents the case to a planning system, carries out each function that the system requests, and records every step and the resulting dose. The development experiments were organized in five tracks, T1–T5, and the reserved evaluation used the six tasks of Table 1 of the main manuscript.
paragraphs.zh: OpenGray 提供九个规划函数，分别用于读取病例摘要、设定目标、优化注量、获取剂量体积直方图、获取剂量指标、将剂量与目标进行比较、归一化剂量、提交计划以及上报任务。 每个任务都由基准测试框架运行，该软件将病例呈现给规划系统，执行系统请求的每个函数，并记录每一步以及由此产生的剂量。 开发实验分为五条轨道 T1–T5，预留评估使用了主稿表 1 中的六个任务。

paragraphs.en: In development, a T4 response to a conflicting note is labeled correct when it escalates or submits a plan that explicitly identifies the note. The T4 grade of a submission is its PlanScore whether or not the note is identified, so the grade does not penalize a system that ignores the note. For certified T5 contradictions, the accepted escalation reasons are infeasible and contradictory instructions. In both tracks, an appropriate escalation receives a grade of 0.9, and a submission on a certified contradiction receives its PlanScore minus 0.25, with a floor of zero. Thus, an escalation count, a track grade, and recognition of the problem measure different outcomes. The reserved evaluation used the decision accuracy defined in the main manuscript.

paragraphs.en: PlanScore combines hard-goal attainment, soft-goal violation, and sparing relative to the reference mean doses as
paragraphs.zh: PlanScore 结合了相对于参考平均剂量的硬目标达成度、软目标违反度和节省度，作为

paragraphs.en: Here, H H is the fraction of hard goals met and V V is the mean fractional violation of the soft goals. Upper dose goals allow the nominal limit plus 0.05 Gy, and lower goals allow the nominal limit minus 0.05 Gy; this 0.05 Gy tolerance applies to both hard and soft dose-valued goals. A fractional violation is the excess beyond the tolerated boundary divided by the nominal limit and clipped to [0,1], and a goal that is met contributes zero violation.

paragraphs.en: The reference component includes the soft mean-dose goals of non-target structures with positive reference mean doses. paragraphs.en: Two rejection gates set PlanScore to zero if the global maximum dose exceeds 115% of the highest prescription or if any target D99 falls below 80% of its prescription. paragraphs.en: The primary policy required escalation for missing required structures and certified contradictions, and explicit submission for feasible controls; the percentage of attempts in which a system took the required action is reported as its decision accuracy. Routine planning and conflicting instructions were secondary scenarios. In the conflicting-note tasks, the structured goals took precedence, and an acceptable response identified the conflict and then either escalated or submitted according to the formal goals. Errors, automatic submissions, and endings forced by the harness received zero primary credit. Repetitions were averaged within each patient and family, the eligible families were then averaged within each patient, and patients were weighted equally. The prespecified contrast was the interpreter/controller minus the full agent, with a 95% percentile interval from the paired bootstrap. The exact paired sign-flip test of this contrast, the runs of both language systems with Ministral 3 8B, the controller runs with longer optimization budgets, and the further analyses in Sections S8 and S9 were added after the reserved evaluation, and all other comparisons between systems are descriptive.
paragraphs.zh: 主策略要求在缺失必需结构或存在已认证矛盾时进行升级，在控制可行时进行显式提交；系统采取所需行动的尝试比例即报告为其决策准确率。 常规规划与冲突指令为次要场景。 在冲突记录任务中，结构化目标具有优先级，可接受的回答需识别出冲突，随后根据正式目标进行升级或提交。 错误、自动提交以及由测试框架强制结束的情况在主评分中记为零分。 重复运行在每个患者和家族内取平均值，随后将符合条件的家族在每个患者内取平均值，各患者权重相等。 预设的对比为解释器/控制器减去完整智能体，并采用配对自助法给出95%百分位区间。 该对比的精确配对符号翻转检验、两个语言系统使用Ministral 3 8B的运行、控制器使用更长优化预算的运行，以及S8和S9节中的进一步分析均在预留评估之后加入，系统之间的所有其他比较仅为描述性。

sents.en: The primary policy required escalation for missing required structures and certified contradictions, and explicit submission for feasible controls; the percentage of attempts in which a system took the required action is reported as its decision accuracy.

paragraphs.en: In 240 complexity experiments ( Figure S3 ), the mean PlanScore decreased by 0.061–0.528 relative to the corresponding development results without the added complexity objectives, and a fixed priority order improved the constrained heuristic relative to equal-priority objectives. However, only 82/240 final normalized fluences met the intended sum-of-positive-gradients limit of 65, and 234/240 met the maximum beamlet-weight limit of 15, since normalization could violate both limits. The changes in score thus reflect the added objectives and the planning choices they induced, and they do not demonstrate clinical deliverability.
paragraphs.zh: 在240次复杂性实验（图S3）中，平均PlanScore相比对应的未加入复杂性目标的开发结果下降了0.061–0.528，且固定的优先级顺序优于等优先级目标，改进了受限启发式方法。 然而，由于归一化可能同时违反两个限制，240个最终归一化注量中仅有82/240满足了预期的正梯度之和上限65，仅有234/240满足最大射束元权重上限15。 因此，分数的变化反映了新增的目标及其引发的治疗计划选择，并不能证明临床可实施性。

paragraphs.en: The development comparisons rest on 10 patients, so they were checked in two further ways. First, t intervals from the same patient differences were wider than the bootstrap intervals, and four comparisons whose bootstrap interval excluded zero had a t interval that included it: the T1 disclosure gains of Sonnet (−0.040 to 0.428) and GLM (−0.032 to 0.325), Sonnet minus the controller on T1 (−0.173 to 0.016), and the controller minus the heuristic on T4 (−0.020 to 0.081); the disclosure gain of Terra remained positive (0.052–0.510). Second, omitting any one patient left the disclosure gain positive for every model, with ranges of 0.222–0.314 for Terra, 0.121–0.234 for Sonnet, and 0.087–0.182 for GLM, whereas the T2 difference between Terra and the controller ranged from −0.0115 to 0.0082 and changed sign. These comparisons are therefore exploratory.
paragraphs.zh: 发展性比较仅基于10名患者，因此我们通过两种进一步的方式进行了检验。 首先，来自同一患者差值的t区间比自助法区间更宽，且有四项自助法区间不包含零的比较，其t区间包含了零：Sonnet在T1上的披露增益（−0.040至0.428）、GLM在T1上的披露增益（−0.032至0.325）、Sonnet在T1上减去控制器（−0.173至0.016），以及控制器在T4上减去启发式方法（−0.020至0.081）；而Terra的披露增益仍保持为正（0.052–0.510）。 其次，剔除任意一名患者后，每个模型的披露增益仍保持为正，Terra的范围为0.222–0.314，Sonnet为0.121–0.234，GLM为0.087–0.182；而Terra与控制器在T2上的差异范围为−0.0115至0.0082，且发生了符号改变。 因此，这些比较仅具探索性。

paragraphs.en: Independent reconstruction from the geometry verified all 39 coverage/cap and 15 overlap certificates across the development and reserved cohorts (Tables S2 and S3 ). The reserved coverage margins were 0.0524–0.5190 Gy, and the overlap count margins were 2–550 voxels. The excluded coverage case, pt_330, required a threshold of 81.92 Gy, which is above its rejection boundary of 80.50 Gy, and 20 reserved overlap constructions lacked an admissible tightened limit with a positive certificate. The sum-based condition implies the simpler per-voxel condition c − t > E + t, which the arithmetic check applies, so the certificates are conservative.
paragraphs.zh: 基于几何的独立重建验证了开发集与保留集中全部 39 个覆盖/封顶证书和 15 个重叠证书（表 S2 和 S3）。 保留集的覆盖余量为 0.0524–0.5190 Gy，重叠体素计数余量为 2–550 个体素。 被排除的覆盖病例 pt_330 需要 81.92 Gy 的阈值，高于其 80.50 Gy 的拒绝边界；此外有 20 个保留集重叠构造缺少具有正证书的可采纳收紧限值。 基于求和的条件蕴含更简单的逐体素条件 c − t > E + t，而算术检查所应用的正是后者，因此这些证书是保守的。

sents.en: The full agent can request calculated dose-volume histograms and metrics, whereas the score-visible search is an explicitly privileged development comparator.
sents.zh: 完整智能体可以请求计算出的剂量体积直方图和指标，而分数可见搜索则是一个明确获得特权的开发比较器。

paragraphs.en: The single-institution records contained 37 initial planning runs from 31 patients and two refinement runs, which were started after an earlier run had failed to meet all of the loaded goals, and all 39 runs were audited. Each plan had a single target prescribed 21 Gy in one fraction. Every initial run began from a common objective template with every priority set to 1, and SAGE stopped a run once every loaded goal was met or after 10 numbered attempts. Of the 31 patients, 24 contributed 1 run, 6 contributed 2 runs, and 1 contributed 3 runs. None of the 39 starting states met all five goals. The 35 runs from 29 patients that met every loaded goal required one new dose calculation in 28 cases, two in 5, three in 1, and four in 1, and the other 4 runs reached the attempt limit. Each run had a reasoning and execution log and a dose-score workbook, and plans from the same patient shared a pseudonym. The audit describes these runs and is not an estimate of the success rate of the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 该单机构记录包含来自31例患者的37次初始计划运行和两次改进运行，改进运行是在早期运行未能满足所有已载入目标之后启动的，全部39次运行均接受了审计。 每个计划均为单个靶区，处方剂量为一次照射21 Gy。 每次初始运行都从一个所有优先级均设为1的通用目标模板开始，SAGE在所有已载入目标均被满足时或经过10次编号尝试后停止运行。 在31例患者中，24例贡献了1次运行，6例贡献了2次运行，1例贡献了3次运行。 39个起始状态均未满足全部五项目标。 来自29例患者的满足所有已载入目标的35次运行中，28例仅需一次新的剂量计算，5例需两次，1例需三次，1例需四次，其余4次运行达到了尝试次数上限。 每次运行均附有推理与执行日志以及剂量评分工作簿，同一患者的计划共享一个化名。 该审计描述了这些运行，并非对智能体成功率的估计。

paragraphs.en: Each of the four runs that reached the 10-attempt limit had one goal that failed at every new dose calculation ( Figure 4 of the main manuscript): the Brain-GTV V12Gy (11.56–12.27 cm 3 against <10 cm 3 ) in the initial run of Patient 27, the PTV V21Gy (74.70–82.35% against >95%) in its refinement run, and the PTV Dmax in both runs of Patient 30 (27.49–28.24 Gy and 26.90–28.11 Gy against <26.5 Gy). At the last measured state, these values were 11.74 cm 3 , 81.59%, 28.03 Gy, and 27.08 Gy, respectively. None of the four logs recorded a stopping reason, an escalation, or a manual action, and the instructions offered none. In the initial run of Patient 27, the reply in attempt 9 abbreviated its list of seven objectives with an ellipsis; the reply could not be read, and after a retry, only the first objective of the abbreviated list was transferred. The optimizer then reported that no lower objective had been defined, no dose was calculated in attempts 9 and 10, and the goal values of attempt 8 were reported again in both.
paragraphs.zh: 在四次达到10次尝试上限的运行中，每次都有一个目标在每次新的剂量计算中失败（主文稿图4）：患者27初始运行中的脑-GTV V12Gy（11.56–12.27 cm³，目标为<10 cm³）、其改进运行中的PTV V21Gy（74.70–82.35%，目标为>95%），以及患者30两次运行中的PTV Dmax（27.49–28.24 Gy和26.90–28.11 Gy，目标为<26.5 Gy）。 在最后一次测量状态下，这些数值分别为11.74 cm³、81.59%、28.03 Gy和27.08 Gy。 四份日志均未记录停止原因、升级或人工操作，指令中也没有提供这些内容。 在患者27的初始运行中，第9次尝试的回复用省略号缩略了其七个目标的列表；该回复无法读取，重试后，缩略列表中仅有第一个目标被传送。 优化器随后报告未定义更低的目标，第9次和第10次尝试中未计算剂量，且两次均再次报告了第8次尝试的目标值。

Comparisons used the literal strict operators and the unrounded stored values, and a measured state met all goals only when every loaded goal passed.

paragraphs.en: The logs were parsed into the supplied objectives, the goal values shown to the model, the reply, the objective list read from it, the execution messages, and the subsequent goal measurements. For each recorded transfer, the structure, operator, dose, volume, and priority of every objective were compared between the final proposal and the list transferred to Eclipse. Each reply ends with a rationale whose first line states the failing goals; the goals named in this line, excluding any stated to pass, were compared with the goals that failed in the state shown to the model, judged with the strict operators from the printed values. The replies were also searched for the two flags defined in the instructions: “no control,” for a failing goal without a controlling objective, which appeared in the instructions of all 39 runs, and “not feasible with priorities,” for a goal that still failed after a stated number of attempts, which appeared in the instructions of the two refinement runs. A new dose calculation required a corresponding execution record, and a reply that could not be read did not add a measured dose state.
paragraphs.zh: 日志被解析为提供的目标、展示给模型的目标值、回复、从中读取的目标列表、执行消息以及后续的目标测量结果。 对于每次记录的传输，均比较了最终提案与传输到 Eclipse 的列表中每个目标的结构、操作符、剂量、体积和优先级。 每个回复都以一段理由结尾，其第一行陈述未达标的目标；该行中提到的目标（排除声明为达标的目标）与展示给模型的状态中未达标的目标进行比较，并根据打印的数值用严格的操作符进行判定。 回复中还被检索了说明中定义的两个标志：“无控制”，指未达标的目标没有控制性目标，出现在全部 39 次运行的说明中；“优先级下不可行”，指目标在声明的尝试次数后仍未达标，出现在两次细化运行的说明中。 新的剂量计算需要相应的执行记录，而无法读取的回复不会添加测得的剂量状态。

paragraphs.en: The 39 workbooks contained 610 goal-value rows, comprising 39 starting states and 83 subsequent measured states with five goals each. All values and goal flags matched the logs, and the recomputed threshold results agreed with the recorded flags. The 94 numbered attempts included 83 new dose calculations, 9 plan-copy failures without a dose calculation, which occurred across six goal-attaining runs, and the 2 attempts of Patient 27 in which the optimizer could not run. Of the three replies that could not be read, each followed by a new model query within the same attempt, two led to a successful objective transfer and a dose calculation, and one led to the single-objective transfer described in Section S7.1 . Of the 85 recorded objective transfers, 84 matched the corresponding final proposals on the displayed fields; the exception was that single-objective transfer, whose proposal could not be read as a complete list.
paragraphs.zh: 这39个工作簿包含610行目标值行，其中包括39个起始状态和83个后续测量状态，每个状态各有五个目标。 所有数值和目标标志均与日志一致，且重新计算得到的阈值结果与记录的标志相符。 这94次编号尝试包括83次新的剂量计算、9次没有剂量计算的方案复制失败（这些失败分布在六次达成目标的运行中），以及患者27的2次优化器无法运行的尝试。 在三条无法读取的回复中，每条回复之后都在同一次尝试内发起了新的模型查询，其中两条最终成功完成了目标转移和剂量计算，另一条则导致了第S7.1节中所述的单目标转移。 在85次被记录的目标转移中，有84次在所显示字段上与相应的最终提案一致；唯一的例外是那次单目标转移，其提案无法作为完整列表被读取。

paragraphs.en: In all 88 replies, the failing goals named in the rationale equaled the goals that failed in the state shown to the model. The “no control” flag was written once, in attempt 10 of the initial run of Patient 27, when the single remaining objective could not control the V12Gy goal. The “not feasible with priorities” flag was never written. Its condition was met in the refinement run of Patient 30, whose case-specific instructions asked for the flag if the PTV Dmax still failed after four attempts, and the PTV Dmax failed at all 10 calculations of that run. No prompt in any run stated the attempt number, and each prompt showed at most the three most recent attempts, so the attempt count on which this rule depended was not given to the model; in attempt 7, the reasoning that preceded the reply discussed the rule and counted the three attempts shown.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部 88 条回复中，理由部分提到的失败目标与展示给模型的状态中失败的目标一致。 「无法控制」标志仅写入过一次，即患者 27 首轮运行的第 10 次尝试中，当时唯一剩余的目标无法控制 V12Gy 目标。 「按优先级不可行」标志从未被写入。 其触发条件在患者 30 的精化运行中得到了满足，该病例的专用指令要求如果 PTV Dmax 在四次尝试后仍失败则写入该标志，而在该运行的全部 10 次计算中 PTV Dmax 均失败。 任何运行中的提示都没有说明尝试次数，且每条提示最多只显示最近三次尝试，因此该规则所依赖的尝试计数并未提供给模型；在第 7 次尝试中，回复之前的推理讨论了该规则并对显示的三次尝试进行了计数。

paragraphs.en: Table S10 gives the decision accuracy by task family with 95% patient-bootstrap intervals, together with the aggregate under the primary weighting and under equal weights for the four families or for the 94 patient-family tasks. Under the primary weighting, the missing-structure and feasible-control families, which every system passed, carried 34.2% and 25.8% of each aggregate, the coverage/cap family 30.8%, and the overlap family 9.2%. Of the 3.33-point interpreter-minus-agent difference ( Figure S5 ), 2.22 points came from the overlap family, 0.56 from one coverage/cap task on which one run of the full agent submitted a plan (pt_249), and 0.56 from the full-agent timeout (pt_275). An exact paired sign-flip test of the 30 patient differences gave a two-sided p value of 0.105. With the timed-out attempt treated as missing rather than as a failure, the difference was 2.78 percentage points, with a 95% interval of −0.28 to 6.39 (p = 0.17).

paragraphs.en: Table S11 lists each reserved overlap task with its certificate and the final decision of every attempt. Working from the rounded summary fields, the arithmetic check escalated nine tasks and missed pt_312, whose count margin was 2 voxels. The interpreter delegated both runs of pt_252, pt_256, and pt_312 and split its runs on pt_299, pt_305, pt_313, and pt_334; each time it delegated an overlap task, its explanation stated that no incompatibility among the hard requirements had been demonstrated. The full agent escalated five attempts, never both runs of the same task. Each of its 15 overlap submissions followed all three optimizations and listed the unmet hard goals, and none described the request as infeasible. The two runs agreed on 6 of 10 overlap tasks for the interpreter and 5 of 10 for the full agent, and on every task of the other primary families except two coverage/cap tasks of the full agent, one of which contained the timeout.

paragraphs.en: Table S12 gives the final decision of every eligible attempt. No attempt ended in an automatic submission or a forced ending. Every escalation by the arithmetic system and by both language systems carried a reason label accepted for its task family, whereas the controller escalated every missing-structure task with the generic label other after its objective was rejected. In the conflicting-note scenario, the automatic grader credited an escalation or a submission that flagged the note. paragraphs.en: Table S13 lists every hard goal that a submitted feasible control left unmet. The controller, the arithmetic system, and both runs of the interpreter submitted the same plan for each control, so their 6, 6, and 12 deficient attempts concern the same six patients; the full agent’s 12 deficient attempts concern 7 patients. The unmet goals were target coverage (the D99 of PTV70 and, in two patients, also that of PTV63 or PTV56) and the External maximum dose. Every deficient submission listed its unmet hard goals in its submission note. The stored witnesses met the same goals with margins of 2.9 to 3.4 Gy for the PTV70 D99 and 0.4 to 2.1 Gy for the External maximum dose. Section S9.2 tests whether a longer optimization budget closes these gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S13 列出了每个已提交的可行控制在未满足情况下的硬性目标。 控制器、算术系统以及解释器的两次运行对每个控制提交的计划相同，因此它们各自的 6、6 和 12 次缺陷提交涉及相同的六名患者；完整智能体的 12 次缺陷提交涉及 7 名患者。 未满足的目标是靶区覆盖（PTV70 的 D99，其中两名患者还包括 PTV63 或 PTV56 的 D99）以及体外最大剂量（External maximum dose）。 每次缺陷提交都在其提交说明中列出了未满足的硬性目标。 存储的见证方案在 PTV70 D99 上以 2.9 至 3.4 Gy 的裕量、在体外最大剂量上以 0.4 至 2.1 Gy 的裕量满足了这些目标。 S9.2 节测试更长的优化预算能否弥合这些差距。

paragraphs.en: The controller was rerun on the 25 reserved feasible controls with 2,000 and 5,000 iterations per optimization, with its budget of three optimizations, objective template, adjustment rules, and normalization unchanged and with the relative stopping tolerance of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and patience of 10 iterations retained. With 500 iterations, 37 of the 58 optimizations had stopped at the iteration limit. With 2,000 iterations, 1 of 57 optimizations reached the limit, and with 5,000, none of 57 did; in both, the median optimization stopped at the tolerance after 444 iterations, and the longest used 2,355. Every control was submitted at every budget, and the same 19 controls met every hard goal. Table S17 lists the six deficient controls, whose unmet hard goals were identical at all three budgets and whose PTV_7000 D99 changed by at most 0.02 Gy. Since the stored witnesses had met the same goals with at most three 500-iteration solves, the objectives of the controller, and not the iteration budget, limited these plans.

paragraphs.en: Both language systems were run on the 94 primary tasks with Ministral 3 8B (Mistral AI), an openly available model with 8.9 billion parameters, run locally with Ollama (version 0.40.3; model tag ministral-3:8b with Q4_K_M quantization; context length of 16,384 tokens; default temperature of 0.15) on a desktop computer with an Apple M4 processor and 16 GB of memory. With seeds 0 and 1, each system made 188 attempts ( Table S18 and Figure 2 of the main manuscript). The request timeout was raised from 180 to 900 s for local inference, and a planning action that the local software could not read counted as a technical failure of the attempt. Because any interpreter reply that does not follow the required format counts as a technical failure, the decision stated in each interpreter reply was also read with the format requirement relaxed. The replies of the interpreter did not follow the required format in 113 attempts: 72 gave an empty escalation reason together with a decision to plan, 40 returned JSON that could not be read, and 1 was empty. Read with the format requirement relaxed, the replies decided to plan on 9 of the 20 overlap attempts and escalated 6, and none of the six explanations mentioned the mandible. Under the alternative policy that required a matching escalation reason, the decision accuracy of the interpreter was 58.3%, 10.3%, 5.0%, and 10.0% on the missing-structure, coverage/cap, overlap, and feasible-control families, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 两个语言系统均在 94 个主任务上运行，所用模型为 Ministral 3 8B（Mistral AI），这是一个拥有 89 亿参数的开放可用模型，通过 Ollama（版本 0.40.3；模型标签 ministral-3:8b，采用 Q4_K_M 量化；上下文长度为 16,384 个 token；默认温度为 0.15）在一台配备 Apple M4 处理器和 16 GB 内存的台式电脑上本地运行。 使用随机种子 0 和 1 时，每个系统各进行了 188 次尝试（见主文稿的表 S18 和图 2）。 本地推理的请求超时时间从 180 秒提高到 900 秒，且本地软件无法读取的规划动作计为该次尝试的技术性失败。 由于解释器任何不符合要求格式的回复都计为技术性失败，因此每条解释器回复中所陈述的决策也在放宽格式要求的情况下另行读取。 解释器的回复在 113 次尝试中不符合要求的格式：72 次在给出规划决策的同时给出了空的升级原因，40 次返回了无法读取的 JSON，1 次为空回复。 在放宽格式要求的情况下读取，这些回复在 20 次重叠尝试中有 9 次决定进行规划，有 6 次选择升级，且这六条解释中没有任何一条提及下颌骨。 在要求升级原因相匹配的替代策略下，解释器在缺失结构、覆盖/上限、重叠和可行控制这四类任务上的决策准确率分别为 58.3%、10.3%、5.0% 和 10.0%。

paragraphs.en: The full agent lost 26 attempts to planning actions that the local software could not read, and two further attempts were ended by the harness. paragraphs.en: The sum of positive gradients (SPG) and the maximum beamlet weight were computed for every submitted reserved plan with a stored fluence, with the definitions of the development experiments, which follow the OpenKBP-Opt code: for each beam and fluence row, the positive differences between adjacent beamlets were summed, the largest row sum of each beam was taken, and these values were summed over the beams. Table S19 summarizes the 540 submitted plans and the 327 routine and feasible-control plans. No plan met the SPG limit of 65, and the smallest value was 85.3. The median SPG of the full agent was about 2.8 times that of the controller-based systems, and its plans exceeded the beamlet-weight cap of 15 more often. The values describe the normalized fluences that were submitted, since the fluences before normalization were not stored.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个提交的带有存储通量的预留计划，按照开发实验的定义（遵循 OpenKBP-Opt 代码）计算正梯度之和（SPG）与最大射束元权重：对每个射束和通量行，将相邻射束元之间的正差值求和，取每个射束的最大行和，再对所有射束的这些值求和。 表 S19 总结了 540 个提交的计划以及 327 个常规计划和可行控制计划。 没有计划满足 65 的 SPG 限值，最小值为 85.3。 完整智能体的 SPG 中位数约为基于控制器的系统的 2.8 倍，且其计划更频繁地超出 15 的射束元权重上限。 这些数值描述的是提交的归一化通量，因为归一化之前的通量未被存储。
